interface.shortDescription: Connect Nexts to the local DesignCraft desktop app.
interface.longDescription: Create page layouts, edit text frames and styles, place images, run data merges, and export documents through the local DesignCraft desktop control channel. Requires DesignCraft to be installed and running with its control port enabled (designcraft --control 7979); the bundled MCP server connects to it with mcp --connect 127.0.0.1:7979. The control channel is loopback-only and unauthenticated, so no token needs to be configured. The plugin confirms the desktop app is reachable before editing, discovers available commands before execution, and keeps the document visible in the desktop application.
defaultPrompt: Open DesignCraft and help me lay out the current document.
Create a two-page spread in DesignCraft and export it to the workspace.
Place images and flow text into frames in DesignCraft, then export a PNG.
Run a data merge in DesignCraft from a CSV and export the merged pages.
